title: Surface-burning characteristics.
officialText:
Reflective plastic core insulation shall have a flame spread index of not more than 25 and a
smoke-developed index of not more than 450 when tested in accordance with ASTM E 84 or UL 723. The reflective plastic core
insulation shall be tested at the maximum thickness intended for use and shall be tested using one of the mounting methods in
Section 2613.3.1 or 2613.3.2.
